crossRefs.note: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be…
“Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”
Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

translations.web: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”
translations.bsb: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.”
translations.kjv: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
translations.asv: And as to every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood, ye shall purify yourselves.
